intervention_basis: The records of this campaign carry no per-candidate guidance_strength field, because ProGen3's forward is not prefix-exact and a teacher-forced replay would not measure what the sampler observed. The measured intervention is therefore the calibration's wild-type-basis per-residue KL, solved before any endpoint existed to match ProGen2-medium's measured KL per arm, and it lives in the calibration artifacts rather than in the records. The per-cell kl_per_residue field of the frozen cell summary is consequently null throughout; it is not a missing measurement.
